items.title: Japanese court rules human voices are protected in landmark AI case
items.excerpt: A Japanese court partly sided with an anime voice actor against an anonymous TikTok user who posted AI clones of his voice, ruling that a person's voice is protected by publicity rights — a precedent for singers facing unauthorised AI voice models. (Follow-up ruling to the TikTok voice-clone suit covered 9/30.)

items.title: Japanese court says voice is protected by publicity rights; US appeals court says AI training is not fair use
items.excerpt: CMU reads two rulings this week through a music lens: a Japanese court lets performers stop unapproved AI voice clones via publicity rights, while a US appeals court rejected an AI company's fair-use defence for training data. Same Japan story as Engadget — pick one.

items.title: Kelly Clarkson Shares Her 'Controversial' Take on AI: 'I Think It's Welcome to the Table'
items.excerpt: Kelly Clarkson says she 'loves AI' and uses it artistically, but argues AI-made music should sit on separate charts rather than compete with human creations — a working artist's line on where AI belongs in the craft.

items.title: Questlove on the History of Sampling, From Public Enemy to Today: 'I See AI as a Parallel to Sampling Culture'
items.excerpt: On Billboard's On the Record podcast, Questlove traces sampling from Public Enemy to today and frames generative AI as the next chapter of sampling culture — with the same clearance and credit fights.

items.title: What It Actually Takes to Read Music Without Sight (and What AI Can Help Solve)
items.excerpt: How blind musicians prep scores via Braille conversion, where AI note recognition and score conversion could help with printed/PDF scores, and why MuseScore Studio's live Braille translation matters more today than AI promises.

items.title: Stability AI CEO: In One Year, Our AI Tools Will Be Essential to Making All Music
items.excerpt: At TheWrap's AI Creator Day, Stability AI CEO Prem Akkaraju predicts Stable Audio-style tools will be part of making essentially all music within a year, pitching the company's media background for working with creators.

items.title: AI Companies Are Raising Millions From Music They Took Without Permission (Guest Post)
items.excerpt: Former UK Music CEO Jamie Njoku-Goodwin lays out a plan for the music industry to fight AI firms training on music without permission — a licensing/training-data policy piece.

items.title: Build a multi-agent music production pipeline on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime Instances
items.excerpt: AWS walks through a three-agent music production pipeline (composition, generation, mixing hand-offs) sharing one GPU instance and filesystem — a reference workflow for agentic music creation.

items.title: Epidemic Sound partners with MyPart to bring adaptive music to PC gamers and streamers on Overwolf
items.excerpt: Songhunt, an Overwolf in-game app, uses MyPart's multimodal AI to read gameplay in real time and pick matching tracks from Epidemic Sound's catalog across 1,500+ PC games, so streamers' soundtracks shift with the action.

items.title: SLEEP CLUB's New Music About The 'Intrusion' Of AI Got Incorrectly Flagged By Spotify's AI Systems
items.excerpt: Band SLEEP CLUB's new single — about AI's intrusion into daily life — was again wrongly flagged by Spotify's AI-detection systems, after their whole catalog was previously mis-tagged: a false-positive problem for streaming AI labelling.

items.title: Superstar DJ Woody Cook on the rise of algorithms and AI in music
items.excerpt: DJ Woody Cook talks about how he uses technology in his DJ workflow and where AI and algorithms should and shouldn't enter music-making: 'it's about not using it in a morally bankrupt way.'

items.title: Who Is Nick Hahn? The Man Behind Dust & Harmony's AI Country Music
items.excerpt: Credits metadata behind AI-generated country act Dust & Harmony repeatedly point to one human, Nick Hahn — a look at who actually writes and produces 'AI artists'.

items.title: 정선아리랑, AI 만나 수채화로 피어난다…음원·뮤직비디오 '이어부르는 마음' 공개
items.excerpt: 정선군이 정선아리랑의 대표 선율과 정서를 AI 기반 창작 기술과 결합한 음원·수채화풍 뮤직비디오 '이어부르는 마음'을 10월 1일 공개했다 — 전통 민요를 AI로 재해석한 지자체 프로젝트.

items.title: Jason Derulo Praises Josh Fawaz, Backs His Use of AI
items.excerpt: On tour in Australia, Jason Derulo praised opener Josh Fawaz and defended AI as a tool for artists and producers. (Edge of window — 2 minutes inside 336h.)

items.title: This is Probably Why Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' Sounds a Lot Like an AI Explainer Song
items.excerpt: Listeners compared Taylor Swift's bonus track 'Patient Zero' to viral AI-generated explainer songs about steel coils and solar panels, sparking debate over whether AI style is now shaping human pop — or vice versa.
